verdicts.reason: A: the 'Find It Near You' CTA shrinks to a tiny pill crammed into the top-right corner next to the two badges, which gives it the same weight as they have. The rotated 'Free Delivery' badge collides with the shrunken product, and the body copy is illegibly small. B: the CTA is at least a clear dark button under the headline, but GROVE drops below the headline, the 'Summer Only' and 'Free Delivery' badges are piled on the left edge with no product next to them, and the body text on the right is unreadably small. B is less bad because its CTA hierarchy and left-to-right flow still work.
